_source: AITMC Ventures Limited Updated Draft Red Herring Prospectus-I dated 30-Sep-2026 (SEBI filing 30-Sep-2026; 527 PDF pages). Rs crore = Rs lakh / 100. Printed page = PDF page - 4 (restated-financials annexure runs on its own folio, cited as 'Annex. n'). FY26 is STANDALONE; FY25 and FY24 are CONSOLIDATED (document p. 81). The issuer's FY26 EPS is on total comprehensive income.

basis.name: AITMC Ventures Limited
basis.outside: none (all figures from the UDRHP-I; peer prices derived from the document's own P/E x EPS)

1.finding: Bonus (1.5:1, Jun-2023) and 5-for-1 split (Sep-2023) fall inside FY24. Basis for Issue Price p. 202 prints FY24 basic EPS Rs 20.41 on the pre-split count (42.05 lakh shares) next to Rs 1.91 and Rs 1.50 on 8.98 crore shares, giving a basic weighted EPS of Rs 4.79; on one share base (FY24 Rs 1.76) it is about Rs 1.68. EPS numerators use total comprehensive income (FY26 Rs 13.51 cr vs PAT Rs 13.38 cr).

2.finding: Operating cash flow -5.90 / -6.59 / +2.67 cr (FY24/25/26) against PAT 8.63 / 16.14 / 13.38 cr: cumulative CFO/PAT -25.7%. Capital advances (+Rs 9.59 cr FY26, +Rs 13.52 cr FY25) appear to sit inside operating cash flow rather than investing (balance-sheet movements match the 'other non-financial assets' line); adding them back gives FY26 +12.26 and FY25 +6.93 cr, still below PAT.

3.finding: Current tax 4.76 / 7.33 / 5.47 cr (FY24/25/26) = 32.0% of cumulative PBT, so profit is taxed. But income tax paid (net) is Rs 11.07 cr against Rs 17.56 cr charged; the current-tax liability stands at Rs 6.86 cr at 31-Mar-2026.

4.finding: Purchases and cost of services from KMP-influenced entities Rs 14.11 cr in FY26 (24.3% of gross purchases of Rs 58.10 cr; 30.6% in FY25). Advances to related-party suppliers Rs 8.06 cr at FY26 (Rs 1.20 cr FY25), 11.5% of net worth. Farmers City International (apparently the subsidiary sold in FY25) now supplies the company. Capital advances Rs 25.81 cr (36.7% of net worth) are unreconciled to named vendors.

5.finding: Objects need Rs 155.03 cr (Rs 20.00 cr debt repayment, Rs 135.03 cr capex) against a fixed fresh issue of 3.50 crore shares: price floor at least Rs 44.29 before offer expenses and GCP (up to 25% of gross). Last secondary transfers were at Rs 17.50 (p. 207); floor is 2.5x that.

6.finding: No revaluation reserve in other equity (retained earnings, securities premium, OCI only).

7.finding: No goodwill. Intangibles nil at 31-Mar-2025 and 31-Mar-2026.

8.finding: Top-1 customer 18.73%, top-5 71.13%, top-10 83.58% of FY26 revenue (88.55% FY24); names withheld for want of consent. Top-1 supplier 20.20%, top-10 69.66%, and three FY26 supplier amounts equal those of related parties; no supply contract disclosed. Delhi alone is 58.47% of FY26 revenue.

9.finding: No contingent liabilities, but capital commitments of Rs 17.41 cr (Rs 1.49 cr FY25) are not provided for. One FIR (No. 33/2025, s. 420 IPC) is under investigation with notice issued to a director (pp. 447-448).

10.finding: No investor presentation reviewed in this pass.

R1.finding: NKSC & Co appointed statutory auditor 30-Aug-2023; the document records no change since. Audit reports on the FY24 and FY25 consolidated statements were not reviewed in this pass.

R5.finding: Reg 6(1) re-performed: operating profit (PAT + finance cost + tax - other income) 21.54 / 24.21 / 9.38 cr FY26/25/24, average 18.38 cr against the Rs 15 cr test; reproduces the document's figures. FY24 passes only at 9.38 cr, and the KPI table's EBITDA uses a different basis (it includes other income).

R6.finding: Khandwala Securities: 8 SME issues listed in the document, all 8 below issue price at day 30 (-4.2% to -67.8%); no mainboard IPO handled. The summary table does not reproduce the per-issue table. Full CIR/MIRSD/1/2012 track record not compiled.

rationale.g1: Revenue +108.9% FY25 (consolidated) then +22.0% FY26 (standalone vs consolidated base, p. 84). Drone sales fell Rs 10.40 cr to Rs 3.40 cr and Government revenue Rs 39.82 cr to Rs 28.66 cr (p. 50); FY26 shows Rs 27.21 cr of stock-in-trade purchases (nil in FY25) and private-customer revenue up on IT-equipment supply (p. 50). Bear = near-flat; Neutral = GISH (60,000 candidates a year from FY28, p. 137) and WISH ramp; Bull = full 20-year WISH concession and drone scale-up (p. 145).
rationale.m: EBITDA margin on the issuer's KPI table 39.92% / 33.85% / 26.74% FY24-26, but it includes other income; excluding it 28.28% / 32.35% / 26.26% (p. 205). Gross margin 55.66% / 54.63% / 46.45%. FY24 other income of Rs 4.87 cr held Rs 4.42 cr of liabilities written back (p. 86). Bear 20% = lower of trading mix; Neutral 24.5% = FY24-26 average ex other income (28.3, 32.4, 26.3 = 29.0%) less a trading-mix haircut; Bull 27% = FY26 level.
rationale.nwc: Issuer's own working-capital table: Rs 34.53 cr FY26 = 32.3% of revenue; Rs 29.03 cr FY25 = 33.2% (p. 39). Receivable days (closing) 335 / 182 / 211; Rs 14.10 cr outstanding 1-3 years (Annex. 14). Bear 36%, Neutral 32%, Bull 28%.
rationale.roic: ROCE on the issuer's definition 46.62% / 33.51% / 23.80% FY24-26 (p. 205) and falling. Terminal set well below it: Bear 12% is below WACC (value-destroying growth), Neutral 17% (just above the 16.9% WACC), Bull 22%.

kpi._cite: EBITDA per the issuer's KPI table p. 205 (certified by NKSC & Co); the table's own definition says 'less other income' but the figures equal PBT + finance cost + depreciation with other income left in (FY26 Rs 0.51 cr, FY25 Rs 1.32 cr, FY24 Rs 4.87 cr).
